options.text: The dry one, because air has the most oxygen.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "Rust is oxygen. Air is oxygen."

options.text: The half-in, half-out one, and the salt-water one rusts fastest of all.
The one fully under water, because water is wet and rust is a wet thing.

image.alt: Four iron nails in four jars: dry air, tap water under a lid, half in water half out, and salt water.
